department: Materials Science (Tri-Campus PhD with UAB and UAH)

deadline.value: Applications are accepted all year, and most decisions are made January through March for the next fall term.
deadline.quote: The Tri-campus Materials Science program accepts applicants throughout the year

also.quote: Most admission decisions are made January through March for the next fall academic term.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

gre_general.value: An official GRE score must be submitted, and the stated minimum is above 300 on the revised scale.
gre_general.quote: submission of an official GRE score | >300 revised GRE (>1000 general GRE)

supervisor.value: Applicants are encouraged to contact faculty about fit and funding before applying.
supervisor.quote: Applicants interested in graduate studies are encouraged to contact faculty advisors to determine compatibility and available funding opportunities

funding.value: Most students are supported through external research grants or fellowships that include tuition, health care and a stipend.
funding.quote: The majority of the graduate students in the program are supported through external research grants or fellowships which includes tuition, health care and a stipend

entry_route.value: The program page does not state a degree-level rule.

toefl_min.value: The program states its own TOEFL iBT minimum, above 79 on the older score scale.

ielts_min.value: The program asks for IELTS above 6.5, so the minimum is effectively 7.

notes: The Tri-campus program shares applications with the home department (Physics, Chemistry, Metallurgical and Materials Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Electrical Engineering). The Metallurgical and Materials Engineering PhD in the catalog is a separate program and is not saved as a second record.
